project.noProject: No project is open yet. Open one to write down what it is called and what it is about.
project.name: Name
project.hint: The name stands in the working page's bar and on the card in the launcher

models.empty: No {{category}} models yet. Add one: a complete endpoint URL, the protocol it speaks, and its own key.
models.gap: No enabled {{category}} model: a {{category}} node that names no model of its own will be refused. Enable one above, or add one.
models.voiceGap: No voice is set: a speech model refuses a request that names no voice. Set one under Preferences.

card.copyTip: Create a new configuration from this one, key included
card.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? The stored key goes with it.

editor.identifierClash: Every identifier this name suggests is already taken; change the display name and save again
editor.noProtocols: No protocol is available for this kind of model. Its shapes come from converter scripts, and none are deployed.
editor.urlHint: The complete endpoint address requests are sent to — not a base URL.
editor.urlHintScheme: It has to start with http:// or https://.
editor.maxVideoSecondsHint: A provider films what its model takes. A telling whose act runs longer is filmed in pieces of at most this long; leave it blank and the app's own ceiling stands in.
editor.groupInherits: Speaks the protocol of the first group, and uses its key
editor.groupUrlTip: Leave blank to use the first group's URL
editor.groupNeedsModel: A group needs a model name
editor.groupUrlBad: A group URL has to start with http:// or https://
editor.groupUncovered: No group answers for these scenarios, so such requests are refused:
editor.groupNeedsOne: Check at least one scenario across the groups
editor.keyCopiedTip: Copied from “{{name}}” — leave blank to keep

system.tierFile: File — a master.key inside the metadata directory
system.switchToKeyring: Move the master key into the OS keychain? Stored API keys keep working; the master.key file is removed.
system.switchToFile: Move the master key into a file in the metadata directory? Stored API keys keep working; the keychain entry is removed.
system.removeKey: Delete the stored key of “{{name}}”? The model configuration stays; requests will fail until a new key is entered.
system.envLocked: MOKA_METADATA_KEY is set; the exported key takes precedence and cannot be moved from here
system.noKeychain: The OS keychain is not available in this runtime, so the file tier is the only choice

secretNotes.keyring: Stored keys are sealed with a master key held in the operating system's keychain
secretNotes.env: Stored keys are sealed with the master key this server was started with (MOKA_METADATA_KEY)
secretNotes.unset: No key has been stored yet, so there is no master key protecting anything so far

generation.systemPromptTip: Applies to every text node that does not carry its own
generation.voiceInstructionsTip: Spoken as directions to the voice
generation.splitCharsTip: The most of a manuscript one chapter is written from, in characters; a longer part is cut at the nearest sentence end
generation.readCharsTip: The most of the chapters one element reading carries, in characters; a longer telling is read a part at a time

pictureTools.label: Picture tools
pictureTools.heading: Picture tools on a node
pictureTools.hint: {{tools}} work on the pixels a picture already has, so they cost nothing and give the same answer twice. {{asks}} do not: each hands the picture to a model, one with a region marked on it and one with a question about it, so each costs what an ask costs.
pictureTools.note: None of them rewrites the file a node holds: what they make is filed beside it and given a node of its own

guidance.configMetadataKeyMissing: The master key protecting stored credentials is missing. Start the server with MOKA_METADATA_KEY set — `moka-server --generate-key` prints a value — or put back the <metadata.dir>/master.key that belongs to this directory. A key created from now on cannot open credentials sealed with the missing one.
